prompt.body: Dense golden rice plants forming a compact field block, harvest-season yellow palette, readable clustered rice silhouette at 32px tile scale.

full_prompt:
TASK: Create one isolated transparent PNG sprite asset for an RPG map object.
Dense golden rice plants forming a compact field block, harvest-season yellow palette, readable clustered rice silhouette at 32px tile scale.

Asset contract:
- Target id: golden_rice_patch_03
- Category: large_prop
- Source canvas: 192x128 px
- Footprint in map: 6x4 tiles
- Runtime size: 192x128 px
- Tile size: 32x32 px
- Anchor: center

Output requirements:
- Pixel art, top-down 3/4 RPG view.
- Transparent background only; no terrain, no floor, no scene background.
- Draw exactly this object, centered and readable.
